rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE (from PR description, confirmed by config inspection): app.json's expo.locales block was pointing to iOS-only localized .strings files (CFBundleDisplayName, NS*UsageDescription keys). expo-cli's prebuild resolver expanded that block during the Android prebuild and injected those same keys into android/app/src/main/res/values-b+en/strings.xml (and other locale variants), while the default values/strings.xml did NOT contain the corresponding string names → Android lint reported the injected translated keys as [ExtraTranslation] errors (translations exist for strings that don't exist in default), which is a fatal (=lintVitalRelease-blocking) issue. FIX: (a) removed expo.locales block from app.json, (b) removed /app/frontend/locales/*.json (used only by that block); iOS usage strings remain in expo.ios.infoPlist (direct Info.plist injection, not via values-b+en). VERIFICATION: `npx expo config --type prebuild` output no longer contains a locales key; ios.infoPlist still has all 4 NS* usage descriptions; android.permissions still has all 7 declared perms. Android production APK build should now pass lintVitalRelease.
